
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiao987334176/p/19107643" title="发布于 2025-09-23 18:22">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">VoxCPM:新一代高拟真语音生成模型</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>一、概述</h1>
<p>仅需0.5B参数，VoxCPM就能用你的声音说任何话：这款开源语音模型在音色克隆和情感表达上突破极限，实时生成媲美真人的播报、演讲甚至方言，错误率低至行业新标杆。</p>
<div class="dpu8C _2kCxD  ">
<p>在语音合成技术快速发展的背景下，面壁智能与清华大学深圳国际研究生院人机语音交互实验室（THUHCSI）近日联合发布了一款新型语音生成模型 ——VoxCPM。这款模型以0.5B 的参数尺寸，致力于为用户提供高质量、自然的语音合成体验。</p>
</div>
<div class="dpu8C _2kCxD  ">
<p>VoxCPM 的推出标志着高拟真语音生成领域的又一里程碑。该模型在自然度、音色相似度及韵律表现力等关键指标上，均达到了行业领先水平。通过零样本声音克隆技术，VoxCPM 能够以极少的数据，生成用户独特的声音，从而实现个性化的语音合成。这一技术进步为语音生成的应用场景带来了更多可能性，尤其是在个性化语音助手、游戏角色配音等领域。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202509/1341090-20250923174634658-472039813.png" alt="380" loading="lazy"></p>
<div class="dpu8C _2kCxD  ">
<p>据悉，VoxCPM 已在 GitHub、Hugging Face 等平台开源，并为开发者提供了线上体验平台，便于用户探索和使用其强大功能。模型在<span class="spamTxt">权威语音合成评测榜单 Seed-TTS-EVAL 中表现出色，尤其是在词错误率和音色相似度方面取得了极低的错误率，展示了其卓越的推理效率。在一张 NVIDIA RTX4090显卡上，VoxCPM 的实时因子（RTF）达到约0.17，满足了高质量实时交互的需求。</span></p>
</div>
<div class="dpu8C _2kCxD  ">
<p>VoxCPM 不仅在技术性能上有所突破，其在音质和情感表达方面也表现出色。模型能够根据文本内容智能选择合适的声音、腔调和韵律，模拟出与真人无异的听感。无论是气象播报、英雄演讲，还是方言主播，VoxCPM 都能精准再现，提供沉浸式的听觉体验。</p>
</div>
<div class="dpu8C _2kCxD  ">
<p>此外，VoxCPM 的技术架构基于<span class="spamTxt">最新的扩散自回归语音生成模型，融合了层次化语言建模和局部扩散生成的连续表征，显著提升了生成语音的表现力与自然度。该模型的核心架构包括多个模块，协同工作，实现了高效的 “语义 - 声学” 生成过程。</span></p>
</div>
<div class="dpu8C _2kCxD  ">

<h1>二、音频样例</h1>
<p>打开音频样例页面地址:</p>
<div class="dpu8C _2kCxD  ">
<p><a href="https://openbmb.github.io/VoxCPM-demopage" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://openbmb.github.io/VoxCPM-demopage</a></p>
</div>
<p>这里列举几个</p>
<h2>宝儿姐</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>叫啥子叫，之前不是说了吗，有姐罩着你呢。那个啥子，小师叔，打狗还要看主人呢，你要是再继续的话，我就是你的对手</pre>
</div>
<p><audio width="300" height="32" preload="none" controls="controls" src="https://openbmb.github.io/VoxCPM-demopage/audio/dialect_zeroshot/voxcpm/baoerjie.wav"><source src="https://openbmb.github.io/VoxCPM-demopage/audio/dialect_zeroshot/voxcpm/baoerjie.wav"></audio></p>
<h2>&nbsp;方言</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>风车车，你不要跑，我来抓你来咯！你莫怪老子心狠手辣哈，哪个叫你娃儿不听话？抓住你，我就要把你做成耗儿肉！</pre>
</div>
<p><audio width="300" height="32" preload="none" controls="controls" src="https://openbmb.github.io/VoxCPM-demopage/audio/dialect_zeroshot/voxcpm/jialaolian.wav"><source src="https://openbmb.github.io/VoxCPM-demopage/audio/dialect_zeroshot/voxcpm/jialaolian.wav"></audio></p>
<h2>&nbsp;粤语</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>九流十家無一能，八仙過海七星聚，六親不認五更雞，四海為家三餐飽，兩手空空一場夢。</pre>
</div>
<p><audio width="300" height="32" preload="none" controls="controls" src="https://openbmb.github.io/VoxCPM-demopage/audio/dialect_zeroshot/voxcpm/yueyu2.wav"><source src="https://openbmb.github.io/VoxCPM-demopage/audio/dialect_zeroshot/voxcpm/yueyu2.wav"></audio></p>
<h2>&nbsp;数学符号标识</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>沸羊羊，如果 △ABC∽△DEF，且AB:DE=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>，那我问你，△ABC的面积与△DEF的面积之比是多少？</pre>
</div>
<p><audio width="300" height="32" preload="none" controls="controls" src="https://openbmb.github.io/VoxCPM-demopage/audio/math/meiyangyang/meiyangyang_math.wav"><source src="https://openbmb.github.io/VoxCPM-demopage/audio/math/meiyangyang/meiyangyang_math.wav"></audio></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>这里比较亮眼的是，VoxCPM居然支持方言</strong></span>。<strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">因为一般的语言生成模型，比如Index-TTS2，只支持普通话</span></strong>，<strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">即使原始的音频是方言，输出的也依然是普通话。</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">还有一点，VoxCPM也支持比较复杂的数学符号</span></strong></p>
<h1>三、实战音频输出</h1>
<h2>Microsoft C++ Build Tools</h2>
<p>注意：windows11安装voxcpm模块会提示报错，因为缺少一些编译环境。</p>
<p>官方地址：<a href="https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/zh-hant/visual-cpp-build-tools/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/zh-hant/visual-cpp-build-tools/</a></p>
<p>下载安装</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202509/1341090-20250923182653184-151465915.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>代码生成</h2>
<p>访问github地址：<a href="https://github.com/OpenBMB/VoxCPM/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/OpenBMB/VoxCPM/</a></p>
<p>下载代码到本地，安装模块</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> voxcpm</pre>
</div>
<p>下载模型VoxCPM-0.5B</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pip <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> modelscope

modelscope download </span>--model OpenBMB/VoxCPM-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>.5B</pre>
</div>
<p>下载ZipEnhancer和SenseVoice Small。在网络演示中，我们使用ZipEnhancer增强语音提示，使用SenseVoice Small增强语音提示ASR。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>modelscope download --model iic/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">speech_zipenhancer_ans_multiloss_16k_base

modelscope download </span>--model iic/SenseVoiceSmall</pre>
</div>
<p>基本用法</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> soundfile as sf
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> numpy as np
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> voxcpm <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> VoxCPM

model </span>= VoxCPM.from_pretrained(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">openbmb/VoxCPM-0.5B</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Non-streaming</span>
wav =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model.generate(
    text</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">VoxCPM is an innovative end-to-end TTS model from ModelBest, designed to generate highly expressive speech.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    prompt_wav_path</span>=None,      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> optional: path to a prompt speech for voice cloning</span>
    prompt_text=None,          <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> optional: reference text</span>
    cfg_value=2.0,             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> LM guidance on LocDiT, higher for better adherence to the prompt, but maybe worse</span>
    inference_timesteps=10,   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> LocDiT inference timesteps, higher for better result, lower for fast speed</span>
    normalize=True,           <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> enable external TN tool</span>
    denoise=True,             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> enable external Denoise tool</span>
    retry_badcase=True,        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> enable retrying mode for some bad cases (unstoppable)</span>
    retry_badcase_max_times=3,  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> maximum retrying times</span>
    retry_badcase_ratio_threshold=6.0, <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> maximum length restriction for bad case detection (simple but effective), it could be adjusted for slow pace speech</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

sf.write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output.wav</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, wav, 16000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">saved: output.wav</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Streaming</span>
chunks =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> chunk <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model.generate_streaming(
    text </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Streaming text to speech is easy with VoxCPM!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> supports same args as above</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    chunks.append(chunk)
wav </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> np.concatenate(chunks)

sf.write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output_streaming.wav</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, wav, 16000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">saved: output_streaming.wav</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>例如，要生成宝儿姐的语音</p>
<p>先下载音频文件，地址：https://openbmb.github.io/VoxCPM-demopage/audio/dialect_zeroshot/prompt_wav/baoerjie.wav</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>修改代码</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> soundfile as sf
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> numpy as np
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> voxcpm <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> VoxCPM

model </span>= VoxCPM.from_pretrained(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">openbmb/VoxCPM-0.5B</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Non-streaming</span>
wav =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model.generate(
    text</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">叫啥子叫，之前不是说了吗，有姐罩着你呢。那个啥子，小师叔，打狗还要看主人呢，你要是再继续的话，我就是你的对手</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> optional: path to a prompt speech for voice cloning</span>
    prompt_wav_path=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">baoerjie.wav</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    prompt_text</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">他们总说我瓜，其实我一点儿都不瓜，大多时候我都机智的一笔。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,          <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> optional: reference text</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> LM guidance on LocDiT, higher for better adherence to the prompt, but maybe worse</span>
    cfg_value=2.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> LocDiT inference timesteps, higher for better result, lower for fast speed</span>
    inference_timesteps=10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    normalize</span>=True,           <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> enable external TN tool</span>
    denoise=True,             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> enable external Denoise tool</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> enable retrying mode for some bad cases (unstoppable)</span>
    retry_badcase=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True,
    retry_badcase_max_times</span>=3,  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> maximum retrying times</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> maximum length restriction for bad case detection (simple but effective), it could be adjusted for slow pace speech</span>
    retry_badcase_ratio_threshold=6.0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
)

sf.write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output.wav</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, wav, 16000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">saved: output.wav</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Streaming</span>
chunks =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> chunk <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> model.generate_streaming(
    text</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Streaming text to speech is easy with VoxCPM!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> supports same args as above</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    chunks.append(chunk)
wav </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> np.concatenate(chunks)

sf.write(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output_streaming.wav</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, wav, 16000<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">saved: output_streaming.wav</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>执行代码，等待5分钟，会生成文件output.wav，试听一下，就是上面的实例效果。</p>
<h2>CLI方式生成</h2>
<p>本地新建文件1.txt，内容如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>他们总说我瓜，其实我一点儿都不瓜，大多时候我都机智的一笔。</pre>
</div>
<p>执行命令：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>voxcpm --model-path <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">D:\file\lmstudio\model\OpenBMB\VoxCPM-0___5B</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --text <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">叫啥子叫，之前不是说了吗，有姐罩着你呢。那个啥子，小师叔，打狗还要看主人呢，你要是再继续的话，我就是你的对手</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --prompt-audio baoerjie.wav --prompt-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">file</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1.txt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> --output out.wav --denoise</pre>
</div>
<p>等待5分钟，会生成文件out.wav，试听一下，就是上面的实例效果。</p>
<h2>web页面生成</h2>
<p>可以通过运行python app.py启动UI界面，它允许您执行语音克隆和语音创建。</p>
<p>执行命令：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>python app.py</pre>
</div>
<p>输出：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">🚀 Running on device: cuda
funasr version: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.2</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.
Downloading Model to directory: C:\Users\xiao\.cache\modelscope\hub\iic</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">SenseVoiceSmall
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2025</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">09</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">23</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">17</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">05</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">28</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">488</span> - modelscope - WARNING -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Using branch: master as version is unstable, use with caution
WARNING:root:trust_remote_code: False
</span>* Running on local URL:  http:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">localhost:7860</span></pre>
</div>
<p>打开网页地址：http://localhost:7860</p>
<p>效果如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202509/1341090-20250923181808221-729245865.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>上传音频文件，修改Prompt Text和Target Text，点击Generate Speech，生成语音</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1341090/202509/1341090-20250923182005053-1391157646.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
